Dear Simon,

I hope this email finds you, based on our conversation on XING I'm excited
to share more details about this opportunity. I’ve been a Head of
Scientific Affairs with Macarthys Laboratories Limited (ML), a leading
biopharmaceutical company in the UK, for the last 14 years. Currently, ML
is facing a shortage of a vital plant-based extract used in vaccine
production due to their previous supplier going out of business.

After extensive research, I’ve identified a producer in Eurasia who
supplies the extract at competitive prices. I looked into it and discovered
the company has been supplying several laboratories in Europe at a lower
price because the plants used in making the extracts were locally grown
there.

I’m seeking a trustworthy associate to act as an intermediary between ML
and the producer. My current employment engagement with ML prevents me from
bidding on the procurement contract directly. By collaborating, you’d be
the face of the deal while I manage the connection with ML, and we can
share the profits.
I believe this opportunity could generate significant revenue for us both.
We will discuss the profit split and essential details you should know
about this herbal extract if you are interested in doing the deal with me.

I look forward to your reflections and future discussions.

I appreciate the time.

Kind regards,
Dr. Andrew



Head of Scientific Affairs at
Macarthys Laboratories Limited
Add: Bampton Road, Harold Hill,
Romford, Essex, RM3 8UG
